description: This file defines interfaces, extension methods, and a class related to configuring recoverable streaming in Orleans, including statistics and cache eviction settings.

classes.name: SiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A class for configuring recoverable streams in an Orleans silo, inheriting from SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator and implementing ISiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator.

methods.name: ConfigureStatistics
methods.description: Extension method to configure statistics options for a reliable stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigureCacheEviction
methods.description: Extension method to configure cache eviction options for a reliable stream provider.

methods.name: SiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recoverable stream configurator with specified name, configuration delegate, and adapter factory.
